entity_types.name: employer_reporting_unit
entity_types.definition: An employer reporting unit that submits WGEA Gender Equality Reporting results for a reporting year, identified by its reporting ABN; its legal form and company-wide scope are not established by this source.

concepts.definition: The employer size range band reported for the WGEA submission, expressed as an employee-count band such as '<250', '250-499' or '5000+'. The band set is publisher-defined and open-ended at the top; it is a band, not an exact headcount.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents an employer headcount band; ext.financial.revenue_band is a revenue band under a named scheme and is not an employee-count band, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The ANZSIC division name the employer reporting unit reported for its WGEA submission, e.g. 'Transport, Postal and Warehousing'. It is the publisher's division label, not a coded ANZSIC value.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.industry_code expects a coded ANZSIC value (division letter, subdivision, group or class) and is owned by business; entity.industry_code likewise expects a coded ANZSIC value for the business. This column holds a division name label for the reporting unit, so type, meaning and owner differ from both.

concepts.definition: The ANZSIC class name the employer reporting unit reported for its WGEA submission, e.g. 'Computer System Design and Related Services'. It is the publisher's class label, not a coded ANZSIC class number.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.industry_code expects a coded ANZSIC value and is owned by business; entity.industry_code likewise expects a coded ANZSIC value for the business. This column holds a class name label for the reporting unit, so type, meaning and owner differ from both.

concepts.definition: The employer name as stated by the employer reporting unit in its WGEA Gender Equality Reporting submission for the reporting year. This is the reporting label, not a verified legal name or trading name, and is not a unique identifier.
concepts.why_not_existing: entity.legal_name and entity.trading_name are owned by business and assert a legal/trading status this source does not establish; the value here is a reporting-unit label for a WGEA submission, so owner and meaning differ.

concepts.definition: The ABN the employer reporting unit used to identify itself in its WGEA Gender Equality Reporting submission. It is a reporting identifier for the reporting unit and does not by itself establish legal form or company-wide scope.
concepts.why_not_existing: entity.abn is owned by business and asserts the ABN of the business legal person; here the ABN is the reporting unit's submission identifier, so owner and scope differ even though the value format is the same.

concepts.definition: The sector classification the employer reporting unit reported for its WGEA submission, distinguishing private from public sector employers. It is a reporting classification, not a legal form.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.sector_tag is a source-stated activity/beneficiary tag requiring a scheme qualifier and is owned by business; this is a WGEA private/public sector classification of the reporting unit, so meaning and owner differ.

concepts.definition: The share of the employer reporting unit's total workforce who were women, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.244 = 24.4%), not a whole percentage; it is a workforce composition share, not a pay gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a female workforce composition share; ext.financial.revenue_band and the GPG concepts concern revenue bands and pay gaps, so reuse would change meaning. Owner is the reporting unit, not the business.

concepts.definition: The share of the employer reporting unit's lower pay quartile who were women, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.75 = 75%), not a whole percentage; it is a composition share within a pay quartile, not a pay gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a female share within a pay quartile; the total-workforce share is a different population, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The share of the employer reporting unit's lower-middle pay quartile who were women, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.38 = 38%), not a whole percentage; it is a composition share within a pay quartile, not a pay gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a female share within a pay quartile; the total-workforce share is a different population, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The share of the employer reporting unit's upper-middle pay quartile who were women, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.25 = 25%), not a whole percentage; it is a composition share within a pay quartile, not a pay gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a female share within a pay quartile; the total-workforce share is a different population, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The share of the employer reporting unit's upper pay quartile who were women, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.16 = 16%), not a whole percentage; it is a composition share within a pay quartile, not a pay gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a female share within a pay quartile; the total-workforce share is a different population, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The average total remuneration in Australian dollars per employee across the employer reporting unit's total workforce, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income; the value is a pay level, not a pay gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a remuneration level; ext.financial.total_income and ext.financial.taxable_income are business income measures owned by business, and the shortlisted GPG concepts are gaps, not dollar pay levels, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The average total remuneration in Australian dollars per employee within the employer reporting unit's lower pay quartile, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay, not revenue or business income; the value is a pay level for one quartile, not a pay gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a remuneration level for a pay quartile; the total-workforce average is a different population and the GPG concepts are gaps, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The average total remuneration in Australian dollars per employee within the employer reporting unit's lower-middle pay quartile, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay, not revenue or business income; the value is a pay level for one quartile, not a pay gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a remuneration level for a pay quartile; the total-workforce average is a different population and the GPG concepts are gaps, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The average total remuneration in Australian dollars per employee within the employer reporting unit's upper-middle pay quartile, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay, not revenue or business income; the value is a pay level for one quartile, not a pay gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a remuneration level for a pay quartile; the total-workforce average is a different population and the GPG concepts are gaps, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The average total remuneration in Australian dollars per employee within the employer reporting unit's upper pay quartile, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay, not revenue or business income; the value is a pay level for one quartile, not a pay gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a remuneration level for a pay quartile; the total-workforce average is a different population and the GPG concepts are gaps, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The average (mean) gender pay gap in base salary for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.244 = 24.4%), not a whole percentage; a negative value indicates a gap favouring women. It is a pay gap, not a pay level or business income.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a gender pay gap; the shortlisted employer_reporting_unit concepts are workforce composition shares and remuneration levels, and ext.financial.total_income is business income owned by business, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The average (mean) gender pay gap in total remuneration for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.244 = 24.4%); a negative value indicates a gap favouring women.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a total-remuneration gender pay gap; the shortlisted total_workforce_average_total_remuneration is a dollar pay level, not a gap, and the base-salary gap is a different measure, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The median gender pay gap in base salary for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.069 = 6.9%), not a whole percentage; a negative value indicates a gap favouring women. It is a pay gap, not a pay level or business income.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a median gender pay gap; the average base salary gap is a different statistic, and the shortlisted employer_reporting_unit concepts are composition shares and pay levels, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The median gender pay gap in total remuneration for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.069 = 6.9%); a negative value indicates a gap favouring women.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents a median total-remuneration gender pay gap; the average total-remuneration gap and the median base-salary gap are different statistics, so reuse would change meaning.
